HUD with 5 forms

A futuristic HUD with five distinct visual forms and personas: Female, Male, Orb/Round, ULTRON and STONIC.

Voice and live conversation

Voice interaction and live Gemini-powered conversation, with mood detection and emotional responses.

Visual feed

A camera feed brings a visual side to the assistant.

Desktop help

Built as an automation tool that assists with daily tasks.

World news and intel

A live module for keeping up with what's happening in the world.

System monitoring

Keeps an eye on the computer it runs on.

Documents and productivity

Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF handling.

Creative studio

Design, animation and timing.

Photo and video

Photo and video editing support.

Memory and action logs

Persistent memory, plus logs of LUNA's actions.

Standalone installer

Packaged as an .exe installer that can run on other PCs as well.

Gold market analysis

LUNA can analyse the gold market for trading. MetaTrader 5 must be installed on the computer.

A companion, built from scratch

I built LUNA from scratch in Python in about 24 days, using Gemini for live conversation. I wanted more than a tool that takes commands, so LUNA is also designed to hold a conversation. It's my personal companion and my automation helper in one place.
